Application Data.NAME: Harmony Strings LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Harmony Strings LLC specializes in the sale and repair of musical instruments. We offer a wide range of products including guitars, violins, woodwinds, and percussion instruments, along with accessories such as strings, picks, and cases. Our repair services encompass routine maintenance, setup, and minor repairs on-site, accounting for less than 25% of our total revenue. We have a physical storefront located in Nashville, TN, with controlled access and basic security measures in place. Our annual sales are under $500,000, and we maintain an inventory valued under $500,000.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a customer accidentally dropped a guitar worth $1,500 during a maintenance session, leading to damage that required extensive repairs. The cost of repairs and replacement parts amounted to $2,500. The claim was settled, and the amount covered was $2,500. Additionally, on July 22, 2023, a theft incident occurred, resulting in the loss of accessories valued at $2,500. The theft was reported to the authorities, and the current status is pending resolution with the insurance company. Total losses for the year amount to $5,000.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station alarm system, monitored 24/7, with perimeter fencing and regular on-site security patrols during business hours.
